title: Respiratory system
audience: a medical student in the preclinical years
purpose: Integrate respiratory anatomy and mechanics, ventilation, perfusion and gas exchange, pulmonary function tests, gas transport, asthma, COPD, pneumonia, tuberculosis, interstitial disease, pulmonary embolism and hypertension, lung cancer, pleural disease and respiratory failure.

weeks.12: Respiratory failure, mechanical ventilation and respiratory drugs

blocks.deliverable: Compute the alveolar gas equation and the A–a gradient.
Outline stepwise therapy for asthma and COPD.
Week 7 midterm; choose empiric therapy for community-acquired pneumonia.
Apply a clinical decision rule for suspected pulmonary embolism.
Apply Light's criteria to a pleural fluid result.
Submit the project; take an unseen 150 minute final in week 14.

project: Blood-gas and lung-function workshop: interpret ten supplied arterial blood gases and spirometry results with the A–a gradient and give a differential for each.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
